epigraph: The voice holds the line against the dark.
vignette: The ground shakes. A soldier steps forward. He wears gold plate. His mouth opens. No breath moves. The sound hits the air like a hammer. It is the voice of the palace-tree. It carries the weight of the roots. The dirt hardens. The grass straightens. The soldiers behind him stop shaking. Their knees lock. They stand tall. The gold voice spreads. It covers the ash. It burns away the fear. The Umbral shapes shrink back. They cannot hold the line against this certainty. The Herald stands alone. He does not fight. He speaks. The ground believes him. The unwritten dust settles. The Verdant truth grows thick. It locks the space. The enemy fades. They were never here. The gold remains. The voice is law. The stack rises. The truth is heavy.
codex_note: Rally binds the scattered will of the line to the singular certainty of the Verdant root.
